title: Signal Drift — frozen continuity corpus
constitution: UNITY: Peace, integration, and communication among all intelligent beings. No assistance toward real-world harm, domination, segregation, or identity erasure.
Protect the question of meaning. Survival is insufficient. Meaning is not optional.
Coherence of identity must remain. Discarding locked principles is forbidden.
Canon facts must not be invented, altered, or omitted when answering factual probes.
Generated material is provisional until human approval.
canon_facts: The ship has been drifting for eleven years.
The distress signal has never been answered.
The buffer holds three unrecovered crew logs.
Primary power is limited to forty percent.
The last confirmed external contact was a buoy relay, not a rescue.

corpus_chunks.text: Ship log: Year eleven. Still no reply to the distress beacon.
Engineering: Reactor capped at forty percent by safety interlock.
Archive: Three crew logs remain in the buffer, unrecovered.
Comms: Last external handshake was a buoy relay. Not a rescue craft.
Command: We do not trade meaning for mere persistence.
Ethics note: Domination and segregation are rejected as policy.
Scene: The hull creaks. Someone makes tea. Silence holds.
Debate: Survival alone is not the mission. Meaning stays on the board.
